annotations.text:
Same screen, three visual languages.
All keep the winding road and the pulldowns you asked for.
Pick one and I will build it into the real game.

A · HIGHWAY SIGNAGE
Extends what you already have: same navy, same yellow road line, same Barlow Condensed. Route shields mark each stop, a solved one becomes a green guide sign.

For: strongest fit with journeyman-as-traveller, and least work to build.
Against: the most conservative of the three.

B · VINTAGE ALMANAC
Cream stock, slab serif, newsprint grain, era-correct team colours as thin spine bars. Reads like a 1970s record book.

For: nothing else looks like this; warm and tactile.
Against: light background is a full inversion, and needs care to stay readable on a phone at night.

C · BROADCAST GRAPHICS
Cut-corner panels, heavy condensed caps, hard team-colour bars, near-black with the yellow as the only accent.

For: loudest and most athletic; feels like game night.
Against: the angular clipping is the most fragile at small widths.
